title: Websites and applications, built around your work
description: I work independently with businesses and creators to build clear websites and useful software.
body:
## What I can build

* Simple business websites that explain what you do and make it easy to contact you
* Product or service catalogs that are easy to browse and update
* Event pages with schedules, registration, payments, or guest information
* Forms and quoting systems that replace repetitive messages and spreadsheets
* Custom applications when an off-the-shelf website is not enough

## A clear starting point

A simple website starts at **USD 100** as a reference. Specialized functionality, event packages, integrations, and larger applications are quoted separately after we define the scope.

[Ask for a quote](mailto:lautaro@lautarogartner.com?subject=Web%20project%20inquiry&body=Hi%20Lautaro%2C%0A%0AI%27m%20looking%20for%20help%20with%20a%20web%20project.%0A%0ABusiness%20or%20project%3A%0AWhat%20I%20need%3A%0AIdeal%20timeline%3A%0ABudget%20range%3A%0A%0AThanks%2C%0A)

## Direct work, real ownership

You work directly with me, Lautaro Gärtner. I have built public sites for local businesses and software products. I will also help with the domain, deployment, analytics, and handoff, so you keep the accounts and access instead of becoming dependent on a provider.

## How we start

* You tell me what the business needs and what currently gets in the way
* I propose a small, concrete scope with price and timing
* We review the real site before it goes live
* You receive the source, credentials, and a clear path for future changes
